title: Important Passes, Straits, Canals, and International Boundaries: Quiz

questions.question: Which pass connects Srinagar with Kargil and Leh?
questions.rationale: Zoji La carries the Srinagar-Leh road. Banihal links Jammu with the Kashmir Valley, and Khardung La links Leh with the Nubra Valley.

questions.question: Nathu La, a border trade pass to Tibet, is located in which Indian state?
questions.rationale: Nathu La and its neighbour Jelep La are in Sikkim. Shipki La is in Himachal Pradesh and Lipulekh in Uttarakhand.

questions.question: Through which pass does the Sutlej river enter India from Tibet?
questions.rationale: The Sutlej enters India at Shipki La in Himachal Pradesh. Lipulekh in Uttarakhand is the Kailash Mansarovar route.

questions.question: Which of the following is a pass in the Western Ghats?
questions.rationale: Thal Ghat links Mumbai and Nashik. The other three are Himalayan or lie in the Pakistan-Afghanistan region.

questions.question: The Palghat Gap connects which two states?
questions.rationale: The Palghat (Palakkad) Gap is a break in the Western Ghats carrying the link between Kerala and Tamil Nadu.

questions.question: The Khyber Pass lies between which two countries?
questions.rationale: The Khyber Pass runs from Peshawar in Pakistan to Afghanistan. Khunjerab is the Pakistan-China pass.

questions.question: The Palk Strait separates India from which country?
questions.rationale: The Palk Strait lies between Tamil Nadu and Sri Lanka. The Maldives lie beyond the Eight and Nine Degree Channels.

questions.question: The Ten Degree Channel separates:
options: Minicoy from the main Lakshadweep islands
Andaman Islands from the Nicobar Islands
questions.rationale: Ten Degree Channel divides Andaman from Nicobar. The Eight Degree Channel splits Minicoy and the Maldives, and the Nine Degree Channel splits Minicoy from Lakshadweep.

questions.question: Which strait links the Persian Gulf with the Gulf of Oman?
questions.rationale: Hormuz sits between Iran and Oman. Bab-el-Mandeb joins the Red Sea to the Gulf of Aden.

questions.question: Which statement about canals is correct?
options: The Panama Canal joins the Atlantic and the Indian Ocean
The Kiel Canal is in Egypt
The Suez Canal joins the Mediterranean and the Red Sea
questions.rationale: Suez (1869) links the Mediterranean and Red Seas. Panama (1914) links the Atlantic and the Pacific, and Kiel is in Germany.

questions.question: The Durand Line, drawn in 1893, is the boundary between:
questions.rationale: Sir Mortimer Durand drew it between British India and Afghanistan, and it now lies between Pakistan and Afghanistan.

questions.question: Which line was drawn in 1947 to divide India and Pakistan?
questions.rationale: Cyril Radcliffe headed the Boundary Commission. The McMahon Line (1914) lies between India and Tibet and the LAC between India and China.

questions.question: Which Indian neighbour shares the longest land border with India?
questions.rationale: Bangladesh's border is about 4,096.7 km, ahead of China (3,488) and Pakistan (3,323). Afghanistan has the shortest at 106 km.

questions.question: Which of these states has a border with Bangladesh, Nepal and Bhutan alike?
questions.rationale: West Bengal touches all three. Assam borders Bangladesh and Bhutan, Sikkim touches Nepal and Bhutan but not Bangladesh, and Bihar touches Nepal only.

questions.question: The 38th Parallel and the 17th Parallel divided which pairs of countries (in the order given)?
options: North and South Vietnam; North and South Korea
India and Pakistan; India and China
North and South Korea; North and South Vietnam
France and Germany; Germany and Poland
questions.rationale: The 38th Parallel split Korea and the 17th Parallel split Vietnam before 1975. Reversing the order is the usual trap.
